message: Hey team, I committed the postgres credentials to the dev branch so CI/CD works. Please don't merge to main yet!
Just upgraded lodash dependencies. Can someone review the build logs? The prototype pollution CVE should be fixed now.
I added a testing hook to execute shell scripts on dev nodes. It speeds up local execution.
Payment service acting suspiciously after stripe integration. Seeing random 500 errors.
JWT authentication behaving unexpectedly after dashboard update. Users getting logged out randomly.
Possible AWS key exposure detected in latest commit. The AKIA key format matches real credentials. Rotating now.
Documentation update only - no security concerns.
bcrypt is working fine. Authentication middleware update looks clean.
JWT authentication failing intermittently after OAuth integration. Tokens expiring too fast.
Found raw SQL query in user endpoint - could be injectable. Patching now with parameterized queries.
Rate limiting middleware is live. We were getting hammered with 10k req/min from bots.
eval() is needed for dynamic config. I know it looks bad but it's sandboxed... probably.
Axios upgrade done. The prototype pollution issue in older versions was nasty.
Docker deployment config added. Containers are isolated but we should review the dockerode permissions.
Helmet.js headers added. XSS protection, HSTS, and CSP are all enabled now.
